standingLines.line: 📺 RATINGS ARE UP! The producers are pleased. New casting directives incoming — Wave 2 talent has been released into your sector.
◈ SYSTEM: "RATINGS DIP. The audience wants STAKES — pointed ones. A PALISADE. Stockpile 14,000 kcal, 350 wood and 60 stone. Walls make such good television. You will thank us when the teeth come."
🧳 A traveler swears Stonebridge, south, is feasting — a whole elk, they say. (They're wrong. Stonebridge is starving.)
SYSTEM: "That was... a lot. The producers say the ratings were historic. I don’t know what to do with that sentence."
💬 Jesse says: "Dreamed again. They showed me teeth. Lots of teeth. Be ready to fight soon."
📺 RATINGS SUMMONS — the numbers are soft and the System is nervous.
📺 ● LIVE — Ratings Summons. YOU is on television.

📺 The brief: a promo stunt, live, sixty seconds, for the ratings. The System suggests interpretive dance about the food supply. The chat suggests worse.

Your body is the budget. Your dignity is the marketing spend.

📺 "But real talk? The next act needs a BIGGER STAGE. I can't stage it with ONE fire — there's not enough of you to REFLECT, you feel me? Get me STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread. Rack up the kills, season your alliances, or feast like legends. Make it worth escalating."

📺 The Iron Pantry. An alien vault-lock on a full pantry. Five tumblers, one hour of air. Pick it and the village eats. Jam it and the cameras watch you starve politely.

People die in this one. Regularly.

The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky.

A vault door the size of weather. Behind a glass panel: a full pantry — grain, smoked meat, winter itself, stacked and lit like a museum.

Five tumblers. One hour of air in the anteroom. The System, almost gentle: "PICK IT. EAT. THE CAMERAS LOVE HUNGER."
